chunks: From him, from Usman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah ibn Mihran, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Three (things): whoever comes to Allah with one of them, Allah will obligate Paradise for him: spending from poverty, cheerfulness with all the world, and justice with oneself.
ai.seo_question: What are the three deeds that guarantee Paradise according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights three transformative virtues that secure Paradise: charitable giving despite personal scarcity, universal cheerfulness, and self-accountability (*muhasaba*). These traits reflect the Shia emphasis on internalizing piety through emotional warmth and rigorous self-discipline, ensuring that one's character aligns with divine expectations even in hardship.
